notes.title: Relentless 0.6.1 Released
notes.content:
For this update, we’ve added more enemies and made the quests more random. Check it out as part of the Steam Next Fest.

Relentless combines the questing of high fantasy RPG, a roguelite gameplay, and a retro 16-bit side-scrolling platformer format. Similar to something like FTL, you only have a limited number of weeks (i.e. runs) to save the world. You will get different endings and permanent unlocks depending on how you did. A typical game cycle takes about 2-3 hours, and contains different quests depending on your choices. It should take the average player about 7~8 cycles to get to the “true” ending.

What’s New:

1. This update has a randomized questing system: Start every game cycle with different quests available to you.
2. We’ve added more and smarter enemies to this update. We will continue to add up to 100 enemies to the game in the coming months.
3. We’ve implemented a greater variety of levels. Take a look!

notes.title: Relentless 0.4.4 Released
notes.content:
We’ve been hard at work fixing and adding new things. 0.4.4 is a big step up from 0.4.3 and offers a much better experience. Here are the main changes:

1. We noticed many streamers got stuck in Everantha and had to play the same stage over and over, making for a grindy experience. This might be fine in the full game, but we would like you guys to experience more of what Relentless offers in the demo. Therefore a few more opening areas have been added.

2. Some controller controls have been changed for a better experience. Block now requires Up + Hold and the activate button has been changed from UP to LB.

3. The Ranger select screen and activate command has been updated to have clearer info.

4. The story will continue to change until the official release. So don’t be surprised if the NPCs say things completely different from a previous iteration.

5. Resolved some game breaking bugs such as sprite mess ups and keys getting locked when hitting Roll + Bow at the same time.

notes.title: Relentless 0.4.3 Released
notes.content:
A big thanks to all the streamers and playtesters for finding all our silly bugs and bad design issues! This game has become so much better because of you.

Changes in this update:
1. The difficulty curve has been rebalanced for a hopefully better experience.

2. The hit up twice quickly in door causes blackout issue has been fixed.

3. Arts have been reduced to 2 slots BUT we now key it just to LT and RT, making them much easier to use. We want to design it so players use arts 40%-50% of the time. Right now it’s still almost 80-90% reliance on the melee weapon. In a future update, we may make it so rangers can swap different sets of 2 arts. i.e. ranger has 6 arts total but can only use 2 at a time.

4. Two new areas have been added.

5. Active belt items now auto-equip on pick up if the slot is empty.

notes.title: Demo 0.4.2 Known Issues
notes.content:
Hi supporters. We put out a small patch 0.4.2 that fixes some issues with 0.4.1. Unfortunately, there are still three major issues that we haven't resolved yet:

1. The biggest issue: sometimes an interaction might not work. For example, if you find that you cannot flip a switch even if you continue to hit UP to activate it, or if you seem to be able to get multiple copies of a key item, the game needs to reset. There's 2 solutions that will reset things, allowing interactions to work again:
 - Quit and Continue (The game will autosave your ranger in that room.)
 - Die and use a new ranger.

2. Currently, there is no warning box on "New Game". If you select New Game your previously saved progress will be DELETED and you will have to start again. Select "Continue" to continue your previous progress.

3. The ranger sprite will sometimes glitch out like Vanellope in Wreck-It-Ralph. Or the weapon sprite may not show. 

We are working to fix these issues as soon as possible.

notes.title: Relentless 0.4.1 : World Map demo update released!
notes.content:
Relentless demo 0.4.1 is a huge update! Although there’s still some imperfections, this version is much closer to our final vision of a sidescrolling roguelite RPG. You can see a quick 10 minute stream of us playing it in the Steam trailers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206259/72ee1f9949a1e8669fc7f6a72a578c2a3aeff5e8.png[/img]

Below are what's new:

[b]*** LOTS MORE CONTENT ***[/b]
0.4.1 has three complete adventures: 2 main story and 1 side quest. Plus new enemies, items, and NPCs. It should be an hour or more of gameplay, depending on how many ranger restarts you need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206259/47bdce53ac659da572e71b4325a3f6a802b37b46.png[/img]

Only 1 adventure is unlocked at the beginning. Unlock the other two adventure locations by fulfilling certain conditions.

[b]*** WORLD MAP CAMPAIGN FEATURE ***[/b]
In this new update, you can select different adventures on the world map. Each adventure consists of one or more stages with NPC town areas in between.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206259/2b4e78eaec378338b323fe82301c259a28a8993a.png[/img]

Thinking back to oldies like Adventure of Link or even Final Fantasy 1, I’ve always liked how in those games you can explore a huge world with unique locations containing different adventures. Or if you compare to tabletop RPGs, the world map is your campaign while the locations each represent separate adventure modules.

[b]*** IMPROVED ARTS ***[/b]
We improved the arts and hopefully made them more fun and useful. Try them out and see how you like them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206259/f45c69718ae761ece3fb1a61db62a21fabbafd77.png[/img]

A word on Art controls. Currently, you can activate an art on the controller by holding down LT+X, Y, or B. The idea is that eventually the ranger can use up to 6 arts at a time. So LT+XYB covers 3, and RT+XYB covers the other 3. In this case, the keyboard controls are actually much more convenient (A,S,D,F,G,H) as they use only 1 key. We’re…not sure about these controls and would like feedback on this. One alternative possiblity is allowing only 2 arts at a time keyed to LT and RT, with the option to swap different sets of arts with maybe the dpad.

[b]*** BELT AND BAG ITEMS ***[/b]
There’s always been Bag items, which are quest items you can’t directly use. We’ve put in Belt items, which can be active or passive. Active Belt Items such as daggers or potions can be used during combat with the B button while Passive Belt Items boost your stats simply by existing in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206259/7ccadf8aa4ae3cd02935eeb4f9f481e945c9d12d.png[/img]

Currently, you can equip them via the main menu. We plan to allow you to swap the items during gameplay in a future update.

[b]*** PRISONER RESCUE MECHANIC ***[/b]
Rescue prisoners during your adventures to unlock new items, arts, and buildings in town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206259/21632cf1daae0dbf44f82ce92ee10e3f0b947887.png[/img]

Prisoner Rescue is one part of the survival management mechanic, where you unlock power ups and new items for future rangers, becoming more powerful with each run.

notes.title: Relentless World Map update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello supporters! We’re preparing a major demo update coming out this month that will showcase a very unique feature of Relentless: the World Map!

We’ve talked about how we wanted the game to have a “Big World” feel. Most roguelites and metroidvanias we’ve played take place in one target location, whether it be a dungeon, an island, or a cave. That has its own charm, but we’ve always wondered if the roguelite model could be spread over a large area like a continent.

So this is how it will work. From the home base, the player can select what location the ranger should head to next. Each location will have its own randomly generated combat stages, town areas, and NPCs. For those familiar with DnD tabletop roleplaying, each location is like a self contained adventure within a campaign, with the campaign eventually consisting of 20-30 adventures. Items and power ups can of course be carried between adventures. This opens up the possibility of going on side quests for mystical weapons and artifacts in addition to the main storyline.

Update to be released soon!
